runtimeTextureMeasurement.environment: Desktop Chrome running actual Cocos build
runtimeTextureMeasurement.scope: Whole runtime texture counter, including runtime/canvas textures; not exclusive to new battle art. Not a phone or OS/driver measurement.
runtimeTextureMeasurement.comparison: The90007336-byte estimate covers28 loaded image dimensions times4 only. Different coverage from the runtime/canvas engine counter; do not interpret their difference as a texture leak.

shortDesktopPerformance.scope: Five isolated desktop samples, approximately1.8 seconds each (one1.9-second actual span). No full-run60FPS, sustained-load, leak-test or phone-performance claim.
